items.name: Bisphenol A
items.quote: production by interfacial polycondesation out of phosgene and bisphenol A
items.equation: C15H16O2 (bisphenol A, 228.291) + COCl2 (phosgene, 98.910) -> -[C16H14O3]- (carbonate repeat unit, 254.285) + 2 HCl (72.916)
items.note: 100 %-yield floor; the real amount can only be higher.

items.name: Phosgene
items.quote: production by interfacial polycondesation out of phosgene and bisphenol A
items.equation: C15H16O2 (bisphenol A, 228.291) + COCl2 (phosgene, 98.910) -> -[C16H14O3]- (carbonate repeat unit, 254.285) + 2 HCl (72.916)
items.note: 100 %-yield floor; the real amount can only be higher.

items.name: Sodium hydroxide
items.calculation: 2 x 39.997 / 254.285 = 0.31459 kg NaOH (100 %) per kg of polycarbonate
items.note: An interfacial polycondensation runs the bisphenol as its sodium salt in an aqueous phase; the 2 HCl per repeat unit are neutralised by caustic soda.

gaps: the dichloromethane solvent of the interfacial process (recycled, make-up rate not stated)
